name: – Daniel Freund – After § 11 – Am 12
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 11 a. Notes that since the COVID episode, the Commission distanced itself too easily from the Treaties to invent EU competences (housing, elections, health, intelligence, weather, etc.), new taxes, colossal debts or other financial scaffolding that jeopardise the financial health of European households and States in the short and long term;
